title: Echo Company, 2nd Battalion, 58th Infantry Regiment, 198th Infantry Brigade, Eagle Rappel Tower Training EPK
credit: Video by Basil Lee, Fort Benning Public Affairs Office (DoD civilian)
unit: Echo Company, 2nd Battalion, 58th Infantry Regiment, 198th Infantry Brigade
description: Trainees with Echo Company, 2nd Battalion, 58th Infantry Regiment, 198th Infantry Brigade, conduct rappel training Aug. 6, 2026, at Eagle Confidence Tower on Sand Hill at Fort Benning, Georgia. The training builds confidence and reinforces the techniques and procedures required to safely navigate elevated obstacles during initial entry training.
